_comment: Payload for: npm run sb -- create --json invoice.example.json. companyVatCode is filled in from ~/.claude/smartbill.env. Run `sb -- taxes` for valid taxName/taxPercentage pairs and `sb -- series` for series names. Set isDraft true while details are unsettled - a draft can still be edited or discarded in SmartBill. issuerCnp is the personal ID of whoever signs the invoice; leave it out unless your template prints it.
